packs.name: Black Sturgeon Lakes
packs.blurb: Two connected basins (16.0 + 13.8 km2, 3.1 km apart) packed as one. Contour-derived bathymetry from a 1988 MNRF transect survey (year from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 33.55 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour. Cool-regime walleye/sauger/pike water with muskellunge and lake sturgeon (ARA).
packs._notes: TWO-BASIN UNION: OHN waterbodies OGF_ID 126226549 (16.0 km2) + 126227979 (13.8 km2), matched spatially to the 1988 bathymetry-index polygon (96%/98% coverage); OGF_ID 124794142 EXCLUDED (different lake near Nipigon, own 1977 survey). Sources: Ontario LIO layers 25 (OHN waterbody), 27 (Bathymetry Point - 0 soundings in envelope and inside both polygons, verified 2026-08-08), 30 (Bathymetry Line), 31 (Bathymetry Index) + ARA water poly segment (LIO_Open07/2); retrieved 2026-08-10. 92 contour features / 7,707 vertices, depths 1.5-30.5 m at imperial 5/10 ft intervals; survey 1988 (index only - SURVEY_DATE null). DEM max 33.55 m = deep-hole cap (30.5 + one 3.05 m/10 ft interval; removes unconstrained spline overshoot; 1,063 cells at cap; basin-B TPS floor reaches 28.31 m vs its deepest contour 21.3 m - same documented cap policy). Bundle depth scale 0.20 m; depth-decode gate: decoded max 33.60 m vs DEM 33.55 m (delta 0.05, within one 0.20 step), 0 saturation cells, max/scale 168 <= 250. Per-basin grid probes (shipped EPSG:32615 / +zone=15 transform): basin-A deepest-contour point -> inside grid, water=1, decoded 29.8 m; basin-B -> inside grid, water=1, decoded 21.4 m; basin B contributes 137,319 DEM water cells (max 28.31 m) - its 28 contours verifiably in the surface. Confidence>=0.4 support 84.8% of water cells (exp decay, 100 m scale). Analysis CRS EPSG:32615 - zone-15 EPSG/proj4 fix AND two-basin-union fix (template read .geometry.iloc[0], silently dropping basin B; full chain re-run 2026-08-10). Thermal: ARA Cool regime; Secchi 4.7 m (area-weighted mean of the two basin ARA records). Species: walleye, sauger, pike, muskie, LMB, SMB, lake trout (larger basin), black crappie, lake sturgeon (ARA by OGF_ID). BsM 28 records (27 sites). No on-lake waterlevel gauge (GeoMet search documented). Sentinel-2: custom per-basin catalog (4 scenes; basins straddle MGRS 15UUR/15UVR); primary 2023-08-30 clear over 94.9% of the union - weed_s2 layer honestly nodata in the far-eastern ~800 m sliver of basin B; verdict GO-WITH-CAVEATS (FAI, 41 ha / 1.41% of lake, fringing beds). Pack 18.8 MB. Zoom 10.5 chosen so BOTH basins frame at phone aspect (union spans 0.2296 deg lon ~ 16.4 km -> ~236 px at z10.5 vs ~334 px tight at z11; consistent with muskoka/wanapitei 10.5).
